description: SPEC 13.1 signed listings. `listing` is the published canonical bytes (UTF-8). payload = JCS(card without signatures); signing_input = protected || '.' || base64url(payload); Ed25519 by the key in kid. Each check runs at `now` against its own `directory_keys` (base64url Ed25519 public keys) for `directory`, with the `revoked` token id; `error` is the core's message and `kind` its stable kind. `replacements` say whether `listing` may replace `stored_listing` (SPEC 13.2.2: seq per identity; another identity needs a later token), `tombstones` whether a tombstone (identity, seq) blocks `stored_listing`. `identities` and `directory_key_secret` are seed-derived secrets for signing more test listings and tokens. `renewal`: `previous` renewed by the identity `ik_secret` at `seq` and `issued_at` with the door whose key pair is DeriveKeyPair(`ikm`) gives exactly `renewed` (SPEC 6.6.1, 13.2.2: only door, seq and issued_at change), and each of `refused` (a `seq` that does not increase, an `issued_at` before the previous one) is refused. `content`: the card text a human approves (ListingContent), `input` in any formatting canonicalises to `canonical`; each `invalid` input is refused, and each of `valid_texts` (SPEC 13.1.2: a variation selector right after an Emoji character) canonicalises to its `canonical`.
